criterion: which assistant-command intent the utterance expresses, that is what the user wants done

categories.name: Set Reminder
categories.definition: Create a reminder for a future task or event.

categories.name: Manage Reminder
categories.definition: Modify, delete, or inquire about existing reminders.

categories.name: Set Alarm
categories.definition: Create an alarm to go off at a specified time.

categories.name: Manage Alarm
categories.definition: Modify, delete, or inquire about existing alarms.

categories.name: Set Timer
categories.definition: Create a countdown timer for a specified duration.

categories.name: Manage Timer
categories.definition: Modify, delete, or inquire about existing timers.

categories.name: Make Call
categories.definition: Initiate an audio or video call to a contact.

categories.name: Manage Call
categories.definition: Modify or end an ongoing call.

categories.name: Send Message
categories.definition: Send a text or multimedia message to a contact or group.

categories.name: Manage Message
categories.definition: Read, reply to, or inquire about existing messages.

categories.name: Play Music
categories.definition: Play a specific song, album, or genre of music.

categories.name: Manage Music
categories.definition: Control playback of music, such as pausing or skipping tracks.

categories.name: Weather Inquiry
categories.definition: Request information about current or future weather conditions.

categories.name: News Inquiry
categories.definition: Request information about current news or headlines.

categories.name: Event Inquiry
categories.definition: Request information about events happening in a specific location.

categories.name: Recipe Inquiry
categories.definition: Request information about recipes or cooking instructions.

categories.name: Nutritional Inquiry
categories.definition: Request information about the nutritional content of food.

categories.name: Contact Information Inquiry
categories.definition: Request information about a contact's details, such as address or employer.

categories.name: Social Connection Inquiry
categories.definition: Request information about social connections or online status of contacts.

categories.name: General Inquiry
categories.definition: Request general information or answers to questions not covered by other categories.
